1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# sources-census.sh — fleet-wide corpus/SOURCES.md census, validation, recheck queue.
3	# Conforms to SOURCES-CONTRACT-v1: one registry table, 11 columns => NF=13,
4	# statuses queued|mined|rejected ("watch" is NOT a status; recheck carries cadence),
5	# community is never tier A.
6	# Read-only: parses shokunin.conf LANES rows textually (never sources the conf),
7	# reads corpus/SOURCES.md, writes only stdout or --out; selftest uses cleaned temp files.
8	# Bash + coreutils + gawk.
9	#
10	#   sources-census.sh [mode] [lane-or-dir ...] [--root DIR] [--file PATH]
11	#                     [--today YYYY-MM-DD] [--out PATH] [--verbose]
12	#   modes:  census (default) | validate | overdue | shared | selftest
13	#   lanes:  lane ids from conf or root *-shokunin dirs, or explicit lane dirs
14	#   default targets: child repositories only; conf entries with repo "." are excluded.
15	#                     use --file or an explicit directory for a specific registry.
16	#   exit:   0 clean or warnings · 1 E/overdue findings (or census missing)
17	#           · 2 usage/env/missing registry · 3 selftest failure; W-codes and unlisted
18	#             lanes never change status (validate missing registry returns 2).
19	#
20	# Output: TSV on stdout — lane<TAB>metric|code<TAB>value…
21	#   census:   rows | tier.A|tier.B|tier.C|tier.invalid
22	#             | status.queued|status.mined|status.rejected|status.invalid
23	#             | missing | FLEET.rows | FLEET.tier.X | FLEET.status.X | FLEET.missing
24	#   validate: E01 malformed row (NF!=13)         E02 id not S[0-9]{3,}
25	#             E03 duplicate id                   E04 duplicate URL+scope (no supersedes)
26	#             E05 kind enum violation            E06 tier enum violation
27	#             E07 status enum violation          E08 opened not a past/present ISO date
28	#             E09 invalid recheck (ISO date, NNd, or symbolic cadence)
29	#             E10 community at tier A            E11 used-by path missing on disk
30	#             E12 row-shaped source outside the ## Registry section
31	#             W01 tier-C mined with non-— used-by   W02 rejected row, thin teaches
32	#             W03 mined row with used-by = — (warnings do not affect clean lanes)
33	#             W04 same URL across scopes (warnings do not affect clean lanes)
34	#   overdue:  overdue<SPC>id<SPC><days>d<SPC>recheck=<x><SPC>opened=<x> — ISO recheck
35	#             dates or NNd cadence (due = opened + N days); report on/after due date.
36	#             cadence<SPC>id<SPC>recheck=<x> — symbolic cadences (e.g. on-release)
37	#             are reported, never judged overdue.
38	#   shared:   url<TAB>shared<TAB>lane,lane,… — normalized URL present in >=2 lanes.
39	
40	# Maintained parser accepts 0–3 leading ASCII spaces before Markdown rows/headings;
41	# 4 or more spaces are indented code and ignored. Frozen manual examples assume
42	# column-zero input.
43	set -u
44	MODE=census; OUT=""; FILE=""; ROOT=""; ROOT_SET=0; VERBOSE=0; TODAY=""
45	declare -a LANES_WANT=()
46	
47	usage() { sed -n '2,38p' "$0"; }
48	die() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
49	iso_epoch() {
50	  gawk -v input="$1" '
51	    function epoch(s,   a,y,m,d,t) {
52	      if (s !~ /^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/) return -1e15
53	      split(s,a,"-"); y=a[1]+0; m=a[2]+0; d=a[3]+0
54	      if (y==0) return -1e15
55	      t=mktime(sprintf("%04d %02d %02d 00 00 00",y,m,d),1)
56	      if (strftime("%Y-%m-%d",t,1)!=s) return -1e15
57	      return t
58	    }
59	    BEGIN {
60	      t=epoch(input)
61	      if (t==-1e15) exit 1
62	      printf "%.0f\n",t
63	    }'
64	}
65	
66	while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
67	  case "$1" in
68	    census|validate|overdue|shared|selftest) MODE=$1; shift ;;
69	    --file)
70	      [ $# -ge 2 ] || die "--file needs a path"
71	      FILE=$2; shift 2 ;;
72	    --root)
73	      [ $# -ge 2 ] || die "--root needs a path"
74	      ROOT=$2; ROOT_SET=1; shift 2 ;;
75	    --today)
76	      [ $# -ge 2 ] || die "--today needs a date"
77	      TODAY=$2; shift 2 ;;
78	    --out)
79	      [ $# -ge 2 ] || die "--out needs a path"
80	      OUT=$2; shift 2 ;;
